review_type: Independent manual working-tree diff security re-review; not a formal Codex Security scan
result: No new blocking security findings in the reviewed diff
confirmed: All seven complete() paths carrying learning context verify the original snapshot after reservation before dispatch and before returning personalized output.

Runtime write_token is loaded with the actual credential settings; deletion or a later settings write fails closed. Ciphertext refresh preserves the token and does not invalidate metadata via updated_at.
Unused-reservation refund is restricted to failed local preflight; it is mutually exclusive with provider-error refunds and settlement. Ambiguous accounting failures retain reservation.
Worker rejects unused action headers and multipart POST before vinext/body decoding, including API paths; response hardening/no-store remain intact and normal JSON/HTML/RSC requests are preserved.
Journal batches remain account-scoped, ordered, deletion-filtered and bounded; the JSON reader preserves byte caps, fatal UTF-8 decoding, cancellation and timeout cleanup.

React/react-dom/RSC are consistently pinned and installed at 19.2.9; CI audits the full dependency tree and executes the production Worker security matrix. The QA harness uses disposable local D1 and stubbed outbound traffic.

checks_this_pass.reason: Main agent runs full verification; no concurrent heavy tests or external requests were started.

limitations: Formal Codex Security coordinator/helpers are unavailable; conclusions are from manual source/diff review.
Pre-dispatch metadata checks are not atomic with external dispatch and cannot recall requests already sent.
OCR and Live voice use separate existing transports; this review does not claim that complete() preflight covers them.
Generated image/report artifacts and external advisory/prompt links were not independently revalidated in this pass.
